$comment: What runs a deployed service on a deploy target (`targets.<name>.runtime`), declared once (ADR-001 amendments 12, 13). engine: the container engine's command line; compose: the compose invocation (a host whose server has only the standalone binary declares `compose` on its target); stack: whether the runtime runs the environment's compose stack (static: a release and its `current` pointer only, served by something else). local: the runtime this machine's own stacks run under (compose-gen's stack, the local infra) -- its `engine` and `compose` are the local invocations too. A host adds one in its manifest (`catalogs.targetRuntimes`).
